name: Nabu
description: A voice skin with Nabu, a small hovering robot drawn live in code: round glowing eyes that blink and look around, happy eyes while it answers, a mouth that moves with the answer, and soft ear lights that pulse as it listens and turn red when the wake word is muted. Light on the device: the robot's body is painted once and kept, so opening it costs next to nothing.
author: Andromedanevel (based on Hovi by Ponderosa)

settings.title: Light colour
settings.description: The colour of the eyes, ear lights, chest ring and hover ring, and of the short lines around the answer.

settings.title: Arms
settings.description: Together: both arms move as one, mirrored. Each its own: they move a little out of step, and one arm goes up while thinking.

settings.title: Frame rate
settings.description: Auto starts at full speed and drops to 30, then 20 fps on a device that can't keep up. While the robot rests it never goes faster than 30 fps.

settings.title: Darkness
settings.description: How dark the robot's white shell is, in percent. Highlights stay bright; the face and lights don't change.

settings.title: Name
settings.description: Your robot's name, shown over the conversation on a full screen. Leave it empty to show no name.

settings.title: Answer font
settings.description: The font for the answer: Kiosk Satellite's own, or Atkinson Hyperlegible, designed to read easily.

settings.title: Accent font
settings.description: The font for the name, what was said and the actions, which take the light colour.
